name: reasoning
title: Reasoning
description: The assistant's thinking inside its reply: open while it streams, the amber lamp breathing beside "Thinking"; folded when the answer starts, the words turning to "Thought for 4 s". Once the person presses it, it stays as they left it. Holds the thought, or the agent's steps as a Timeline.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/reasoning.md. SwiftUI: MetalReasoning in the MetalUI Swift package.
